description:
The lovers of funky vibes and smooth grooves can really look forward to this: The debut album by Quintin Copper & Nas Mellow will see the light of the day this spring via Sonar Kollektiv and will bring back the funk to Germany. As a pre-taste the two Swabians are serving the single «Breathe Easy».

An incredibly joyous song tiding one over the darker days in the year. The voice of Nasir Marc Imam aka Nas Mellow sounds almost eerily familiar and is not only supported by Copper’s well-balanced production but also by one of the coolest background choirs you will hear this year.

The remix by Hydrogenii, one half of PH-Wert, DJ and beat producer from Pforzheim treats «Breathe Easy» for the dancefloor or wherever in the next few weeks people will dance to music. Sitting calmly while listening to it is almost impossible!
